recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, centered minimalist composition featuring a bold geometric title, a block of light grey cursive handwriting, and a small geometric icon at the bottom, all set against a subtly textured off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry along the central axis
High contrast between the black title and the white background
Low contrast between the grey script and the white background
Hierarchical scale descending from top to bottom
coreInvariants: Pure white or very light grey background
Combination of rigid geometric forms and fluid organic script

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The title occupies the upper-middle third at a large scale; the script occupies the center at a medium scale; the icon is at the bottom at a small scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold, black geometric title 'BE' acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow, starting at the bold title, moving through the light text, and ending at the bottom icon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space surrounding the central column of content to create a sense of calm and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a clean, paper-like canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the primary title and bottom icon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light cool-grey for the secondary handwritten text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high-value contrast between black and white, low-value contrast between grey and white.

letterConstructionRules: Title uses uniform stroke weight with sharp 90-degree angles
Script uses a continuous, monolinear cursive flow with low slant
Open counters in the geometric typeface
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' in the title features a shortened middle bar that does not touch the vertical stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast pairing of a rigid, architectural sans-serif with a soft, personal handwriting style.
graphicDevices: Geometric logo composed of two mirrored trapezoids

preserve: The gap in the letter E
The light grey color of the script
avoid: Tight leading in the body text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura or ITC Avant Garde Gothic
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set uppercase display style.
Captures the thin, elegant, and airy cursive quality.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution, square off-white background with a very subtle paper grain or watercolor texture. Place two small, black, vertical trapezoidal shapes mirrored at the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay a large, black geometric sans-serif title in the upper center. Below it, add 5 lines of light grey, monolinear cursive text with wide line spacing, all centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the middle bar of the 'E' detached?
Is the cursive text significantly lighter in value than the title?
Is there ample white space on all sides?

mustRedesign: Exact handwriting samples from the original

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on geometric elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grey text is not too dark to maintain hierarchy
Verify the background texture is subtle and not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a bold geometric display font with a light, airy script in a centered vertical stack on a textured white canvas for a minimalist, modern look.
